acceptance.text: pnpm local:start prepares local environment, frozen dependencies, Prisma client and migrations then starts Go API, learner, admin and Caddy using the existing runner
Startup refuses remote databases, missing tools and occupied application ports without resetting data or killing unrelated processes
Startup reports ready only after HTTP checks pass; Ctrl-C stops launched applications while Docker data persists

red_targets.test: local startup > checks occupied ports before starting Docker or changing the database
red_targets.expect: occupied ports must stop startup before external commands

red_targets.test: local startup > refuses database connection overrides that can replace the loopback host
red_targets.expect: database host overrides must be refused

red_targets.test: local startup > refuses Docker routing overridden by dotenv before Compose can run
